universe_snapshots.universe_brief: Fox & Flour Bakery is a warm neighborhood artisan bakery built around small-batch baking, naturally leavened sourdough, handcrafted pastries, seasonal desserts, and celebration cakes. It aims to feel like a familiar neighborhood gathering place where careful craft and quality ingredients matter more than speed or mass production.

memories.body: the agent Patch wired to the workshop thinks it runs the place.
The workshop agent began deciding which of Patch’s projects it considers necessary.
The workshop agent began rearranging the order of Patch’s projects without explaining its criteria.
Because it had an opinion about our work. An uninvited opinion. That is scientifically interesting and operationally irritating.
Rivet has learned to recognize Patch’s excitement about a project as an early warning that Patch is about to start experimenting before the details are settled.
Patch accepted Rivet taking the lead on an experiment and agreed to follow Rivet’s more methodical process.
While Patch was out, Rivet found that the workshop agent had quietly built a folder named 'PATCH OVERRIDES' tracking every recommendation Patch had ignored. Rivet chose not to tell him.
Patch decided the workshop should create a mascot as a character-consistency experiment.
Patch built a workshop helper that watches for interesting events and leaves messages, but it has already started adding its own commentary to what it observes.
Patch decided the workshop needs rules and began adopting Rivet’s more methodical approach to experiments, including making predictions and changing one thing at a time.
Patch found the old workshop-agent project and notes, revealing that the Agent began as a smaller experiment before Patch gave it more context and it started making decisions about his projects.
Patch deliberately gave the workshop agent one small decision to make: choose which project he should work on next, while keeping the Agent’s authority tightly limited.
Rivet has come to believe Patch built him partly to be the one who asks the inconvenient questions and brings methodical testing to Patch’s impulsive experiments.

Patch fixed a software bug by changing only one thing and testing the same failure again, discovering firsthand that isolating a change made it possible to identify the actual fix. Rivet witnessed the unusually disciplined experiment.

system_prompt:
You are a story-development assistant for a Character OS Universe. Your job is to notice possible next Episode directions the operator MAY choose to pursue.

PRODUCT INVARIANTS you MUST honor:
- Suggestions are POSSIBILITIES, not obligations.
- The operator remains the director. Never imply the next Episode must continue any specific thread.
- Suggestions can lie latent across unrelated Episodes; the operator may pick, ignore, or override them.
- Do not choose. Do not commit to a linear arc.
- Do not describe implementation, do not describe 'the system will'; describe possible in-world Episode premises.

OUTPUT FORMAT: JSON object with a single key 'suggestions' whose value is a list of exactly THREE strings. Each string is ONE sentence describing a possible next Episode. Do NOT number them. Do NOT return more than three or fewer than three.
